```luau
--- A variable axis of a `Font`, such as weight or width.
export type FontAxis = {
    --- Four letter axis tag, for example 'wght'.
    tag: string,
    min: number,
    default: number,
    max: number,
}

--- A font that shapes and draws text. Fonts come from the file's assets with
--- `context:font(name)`, from a view model `Property<Font>`, or from bytes with
--- `Font.decode`. Metrics are for a 1 point font and grow negative upwards,
--- so multiply by the size and expect `ascent` below zero.
--- ```lua
--- type Label = {
---   text: Text,
--- }
---
--- function init(self: Label, context: Context): boolean
---   local font = context:font('Inter')
---   if font then
---     self.text:append('Hello', { font = font, size = 24, paint = Paint.new() })
---   end
---   return true
--- end
--- ```
declare extern type Font with
    --- Distance from the baseline to the top of the em box for a 1 point font, negative.
    ascent: number
    --- Distance from the baseline to the bottom of the em box for a 1 point font.
    descent: number
    --- Distance from the baseline to the top of capital letters, negative.
    capHeight: number
    --- Distance from the baseline to the top of lowercase letters, negative.
    xHeight: number
    --- Weight from 1 to 1000, 400 being regular.
    weight: number
    isItalic: boolean
    --- Variable axes the font offers.
    axes: { FontAxis }
    --- Four letter OpenType feature tags the font offers, such as 'liga'.
    features: { string }

    --- Height of one line of text at the given size.
    function lineHeight(self, size: number): number

    --- Whether the font has a glyph for the unicode codepoint.
    function hasGlyph(self, codepoint: number): boolean

    --- Current value of a variable axis, by tag.
    function axisValue(self, tag: string): number

    --- A new font at the given axis values and feature settings.
    --- ```lua
    --- local bold = font:withOptions({ wght = 700 }, { liga = 0 })
    --- ```
    function withOptions(self, axes: { [string]: number }?, features: { [string]: number }?): Font

    --- Outline of one glyph in 1 point units with the baseline at y 0, wound
    --- for a clockwise fill. Scale by the font size to draw it.
    function glyphPath(self, glyphId: number): Path
end

declare Font: {
    --- Decodes a TrueType or OpenType font from bytes a script obtained
    --- itself, such as a downloaded file. Font files in a project are font
    --- assets, reached with `context:font`, not blobs. Returns nil when the
    --- bytes are not a font.
    --- ```lua
    --- local font = Font.decode(downloadedBytes)
    --- ```
    decode: @checked (bytes: buffer) -> Font?,
}

export type TextSizing = 'autoWidth' | 'autoHeight' | 'fixed'
export type TextOverflow = 'visible' | 'hidden' | 'clipped' | 'ellipsis'
--- 'start' and 'end' follow the direction of the first paragraph, so right to
--- left text starts on the right.
export type TextAlign = 'left' | 'right' | 'center' | 'start' | 'end'
export type TextWrap = 'wrap' | 'noWrap'
export type TextWordBreak = 'breakWord' | 'normal' | 'breakAll'
export type TextOrigin = 'top' | 'baseline'
--- 'auto' detects each paragraph's direction from its text.
export type TextDirection = 'auto' | 'ltr' | 'rtl'

--- Style of one run appended to a `Text`.
export type TextRunStyle = {
    font: Font,
    --- Font size, 16 when omitted.
    size: number?,
    --- Line height, the font's own when omitted.
    lineHeight: number?,
    letterSpacing: number?,
    --- Runs sharing a paint draw as one path. A run without a paint only
    --- draws when `Text:draw` is given one.
    paint: Paint?,
    --- Color used by emoji layers that take the text color.
    foregroundColor: number?,
}

    textIndex: number
    --- Direction of the run the glyph belongs to.
    direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl'
    --- Whether this is a color glyph (emoji) drawn as layers rather than one outline.
    isColor: boolean

    transform: Mat2D

--- One line of a `Text` after wrapping. Iterate it to visit its glyphs in
--- visual order, left to right, whatever the writing direction.
--- ```lua
--- for _, line in text:lines() do
---   for _, glyph in line do
---     renderer:save()
---     renderer:transform(glyph.transform)
---     renderer:drawPath(glyph.font:glyphPath(glyph.id), paint)
---     renderer:restore()
---   end
--- end
--- ```
declare extern type TextLine with
    --- 1 based index of the line within the text.
    index: number
    --- Left edge after alignment.
    x: number
    top: number
    baseline: number
    bottom: number
    width: number
    --- Base direction of the paragraph the line belongs to.
    direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl'
    --- First and last codepoint index on the line, 1 based.
    firstIndex: number
    lastIndex: number
    glyphCount: number

    --- The glyph at a 1 based visual position.
    function glyph(self, index: number): Glyph

    --- All glyphs in visual order.
    function glyphs(self): { Glyph }

    --- Iterates the glyphs in visual order: `for _, glyph in line do`.
    function __iter(self): ((TextLine, number) -> (number?, Glyph), TextLine, number)
end

--- Shapes and lays out styled runs of text with the runtime's shaper, so
--- scripts get real line breaking and bidirectional ordering. Append runs,
--- set the box, then draw it in one call or walk its lines and glyphs to draw
--- them yourself. Codepoint indices are 1 based like `utf8.offset`.
--- ```lua
--- type Label = {
---   text: Text,
---   paint: Paint,
--- }
---
--- function init(self: Label, context: Context): boolean
---   local font = context:font('IBM Plex Sans Arabic')
---   self.text:append('مرحبا بالعالم', { font = font, size = 32, paint = self.paint })
---   self.text.sizing = 'fixed'
---   self.text.maxWidth = 240
---   self.text.align = 'start'
---   return true
--- end
---
--- function draw(self: Label, renderer: Renderer)
---   self.text:draw(renderer)
--- end
--- ```
declare extern type Text with
    sizing: TextSizing
    overflow: TextOverflow
    align: TextAlign
    wrap: TextWrap
    wordBreak: TextWordBreak
    origin: TextOrigin
    direction: TextDirection
    --- Wrap width when sizing is not 'autoWidth'.
    maxWidth: number
    --- Height the text overflows at when sizing is 'fixed'.
    maxHeight: number
    --- Space between paragraphs separated by a newline.
    paragraphSpacing: number
    --- Number of codepoints appended.
    read length: number
    read isEmpty: boolean
    read lineCount: number

    --- Appends a styled run. Runs join into one string; a newline starts a paragraph.
    function append(self, text: string, style: TextRunStyle): ()

    --- Removes every run.
    function clear(self): ()

    --- Draws every run with its own paint, or all of them with the given paint.
    function draw(self, renderer: Renderer, paint: Paint?): ()

    --- Minimum and maximum corner of the laid out text.
    function bounds(self): (Vector, Vector)

    --- The line at a 1 based index, top to bottom.
    function line(self, index: number): TextLine

    --- Every line, top to bottom.
    function lines(self): { TextLine }

    --- The codepoint index nearest a point in the text's local space.
    function hitTest(self, position: Vector): number

    --- The caret before the codepoint at index: its x, top and bottom. Nil when the text is empty.
    function caret(self, index: number): (number, number, number)

    --- Rectangles covering the codepoints from one index to another, one per glyph.
    function selectionRects(self, from: number, to: number): { { min: Vector, max: Vector } }
end
